description: nb at a pinned revision with one defect planted in how a run's transcript numbers its turns, which shows only when the transcript is replayed and is caught by none of nb's tests

run: apt-get update -q && apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends jq >/dev/null && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

echo  | base64 -d | git apply && rm -rf .git && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.name=proctor -c user.email=proctor@localhost commit -qm 'nb'
